value.rationale: For a natural unit-deleted principal Ramanujan matrix, a determinant does not describe congruence obstructions. The exact integer cokernel and sharp kernel count for every modulus m provide a complete and reusable classification across all squarefree n with arbitrarily many factors. The extra Euler totient term has a structural p-adic explanation.
